_: Hội thoại nghe A1 / A2 kiểu Cambridge (2 người; có số, giờ, giá, đánh vần). AI soạn 25/10/2026, chưa người thật kiểm. test = 1: giữ cho Thi chuyển cấp. A = giọng nữ, B = giọng nam.

items.title: At the Café
items.tvi: Gọi đồ ở quán cà phê
lines: Can I have a cup of tea, please?
Large, please. And a chocolate cake.

qs.q: What drink does the woman order?

items.title: A New Student
lines: Hi, are you a new student?
Yes. My name is Ben. B-E-N.
Nice to meet you, Ben. How old are you?
Me too! Which class are you in?

items.title: What Time Is the Film?
lines: Let's go to the cinema on Saturday.
Good idea. What time is the film?
It starts at a quarter past seven.
OK. Let's meet at the bus stop at half past six.

qs.q: When do they go to the cinema?
What time does the film start?

items.title: Buying a T-shirt
lines: Yes. How much is this blue T-shirt?
Have you got it in green?
Yes, here you are. It's the same price.

qs.q: What does the woman want to buy?

items.title: My Family Photo
lines: Yes. This is my mum and this is my dad.
Who is the girl with the cat?
That's my sister, Anna. She's nine.
That's my little brother. He's one.

items.title: Where Is the Bank?
lines: Excuse me, where is the bank?
Go straight on and turn left.
Yes. The bank is next to the supermarket.
No, it's five minutes on foot.

qs.q: What is next to the bank?
How long does it take to walk?

items.title: The Weekend
lines: What do you do at the weekend?
On Saturday morning I play tennis.
I visit my grandma. We cook lunch together.

qs.q: What does she play on Saturday?
Who does she visit on Sunday?

items.title: Phone Number
lines: Can I have your phone number?
Sorry, can you say that again?
It's tom at mail dot com. T-O-M.

qs.q: What does the woman ask him to do?
How do you spell his name?

items.title: At the Library
lines: Hello. I want to borrow this book.
Thank you. Bring it back on Friday.
Friday? OK. Can I take two books?

qs.q: What is the girl's family name?
When must she bring the book back?
How many books can she take?

items.title: A Birthday Party
lines: Can you come to my birthday party?
At my house. It's number 25, Green Street.

items.title: Booking a Table
lines: Hi. I'd like to book a table for Friday evening.
Sorry, we're full at eight. Is half past eight OK?
Yes, that's fine. My name is Clare. C-L-A-R-E.
Thank you, Clare. See you on Friday.

qs.q: How many people is the table for?
Why can't she have eight o'clock?

items.title: At the Doctor's
lines: I've had a headache for three days, and I feel very tired.
Yes, a little. Thirty-eight degrees this morning.
OK. Take this medicine twice a day, after meals, and drink lots of water.
No. Stay at home for two days.

qs.q: How long has she had a headache?
How often should she take the medicine?
What does the doctor say about work?
qs.a: Stay at home for two days

items.title: Train Tickets
lines: Two tickets to Hue, please. For tomorrow.
Return, please. We're coming back on Sunday.
The morning train leaves at 7:40 and arrives at 2:15.
That's good. How much is it?

qs.q: What kind of tickets does she buy?

items.title: A Change of Plan
lines: Hi Mai, it's Tom. Are we still meeting at the museum tomorrow?
Sorry, I can't go in the morning. I have to help my mum.
Yes, after two o'clock is fine. Can we meet at the café opposite the museum?
Sure. Let's say quarter to three.

qs.q: Why can't Mai go in the morning?
qs.a: She has to help her mother

items.title: Lost Bag
lines: Excuse me, I left my bag on the bus this morning.
Number 32. I got off at the hospital at about nine.
What does the bag look like?
It's black, with a red umbrella and my glasses inside.
Wait a minute... Yes, someone brought it in. Here you are.

qs.q: What is NOT in the bag?

items.title: English Course
items.tvi: Hỏi về khoá học tiếng Anh
lines: Hello, I'm calling about the evening English course.
Yes. Classes are on Tuesday and Thursday, from six to eight.
On the fifteenth of March. It lasts ten weeks.
And how much does it cost?
Two million dong, and the books are free.

items.title: Holiday Plans
lines: Where are you going for your holiday?
We're going to Da Lat for five days in July.
No, we're taking the night bus. It's cheaper.
At my uncle's house. He has a big garden with lots of flowers.

items.title: New Flat
lines: It's great. It's bigger than my old one. It has two bedrooms.
Yes, it's only ten minutes by bike. But the kitchen is quite small.
Four million a month. That's OK for me.

qs.q: How does he go to work?
What is the problem with the flat?

items.title: At the Hotel
lines: Good afternoon. Welcome to the Sea View Hotel.
Hi. I have a booking for three nights. My name is Nguyen, N-G-U-Y-E-N.
Yes, a double room. You're in room 418, on the fourth floor.
From half past six to ten, in the restaurant next to the pool.

qs.q: How many nights will she stay?

qs.a: In the restaurant next to the pool

items.title: Sports Club
lines: I'd like to join the swimming club.
Then it's 150,000 dong a month. Lessons are on Saturday mornings at nine.
Do I need to bring anything?
Just a towel and your student card.

qs.q: Which club does she want to join?
How much is it a month for students?

qs.a: A towel and her student card
